Load regulation with that offset taken out is Table~\ref{tab:ampab-mc-regulation}. The window is frozen at the same two voltages for every sample, so a weak sample cannot report better accuracy over a narrower range. Both distributions are right-skewed, so the median, percentiles and worst sample are quoted and mean \(\pm\,3\sigma\) is not.}
